blocks.text: Okada Manila celebrated its 10th anniversary and welcomed the festive season with an evening of milestone tributes, live performances, and the Grand Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony. The occasion also marked the opening of the Magical Holiday Village, inviting families and friends to come together for festive dining, shopping, entertainment, and holiday fun. Held at The Fountain Foyer, the evening unfolded in two distinct programs: an anniversary celebration reflecting on the resort’s first decade and its vision for the future, followed by a holiday launch introducing new experiences for guests to enjoy across the resort.
